title: Local events schild.<thing>.<verb>.v1 (CloudEvents 1.0, structured JSON)
description: Events the client writes on its own server (concept 21 §2.1). They never leave the server: full visitor IP and location in plaintext (E7), like any server log. Secrets (passwords, tokens, cookies, Authorization, e-mail addresses) are redacted before storage, request bodies are never stored. Unsigned: they are local records, not messages.

ip.description: Full visitor IP in plaintext (local only, E7).

matchedRule.description: v0.6 (D73): one rule that matched, with the repository it belongs to. id is the SecRule id; for crowdsec the id of the matching AND-group, the crowdsec object names the hub rule.

path.description: The path schild inspected (D33 amendment 2026-10-29: of the last evaluation when schild evaluated the request more than once, never the path after a later rewrite).

checked_paths.description: D33 amendment (initiator, 2026-10-29): present only when schild evaluated this request more than once (e.g. again in handle_errors after handle_path stripped a prefix): the paths every evaluation inspected, in order, redacted as path; above 4 evaluations the first three and the last. The last equals path. One HTTP request writes one event and counts once (contract/monitoring.Recheck, vectors request-recheck); rules are merged over the evaluations, score is the highest.

query.description: Query string with values of secret-looking parameters replaced by [redacted].

sampled.description: Unremarkable requests are only recorded as a sample.

wouldBlockReason.description: v0.5 (D36 open items, 2026-10-29): why a request schild would have blocked was passed (UI: "Erkannt, aber durchgelassen: ..."). Only with outcome would_block; when several apply the first in this order: gateway_observe (the test profile; before D89 schild.yaml mode observe), site_observe (the website is set to observe while the gateway blocks), learning (learning period of a fresh installation), scenario_observe (the behaviour scenario, rate limit or detector is set to observe), source_detect (D90: the rule source that matched is set to detect), settling (D90: the rule is a CrowdSec update that still settles), allowlist (the client is on the allowlist or an exception covers it), shared_address (the client's address is shared - cgnat, mobile or tor - and is never blocked by address).

ruleActor.description: Who changed it. With agent the token and its label are named, otherwise never.

repositorySwitched.description: v0.6 (D73): the state of a rule repository changed, from the dashboard or through the agent API. Written for every change of the effective state. Local only.

state_source.description: state_source after the change; config or default after reset_state.

ruleRef.description: A rule of a repository: the SecRule id as a string (crowdsec: the base id, the hub name in name).

ruleDisabledChange.description: v0.6 (D73): a person or an agent disabled or enabled one rule (schild.rule.disabled.v1, schild.rule.enabled.v1). CRS and local rules are rebuilt without it, a crowdsec rule stops at once. Local only.

note.description: Text of the person or agent, sanitised.

ruleApprovalChange.description: v0.6 (D73): a person or an agent approved or rejected one version of a rule update (schild.rule.approved.v1, schild.rule.rejected.v1). An approval acts at once, without settling; a rejected version never runs. Local only.

note.description: Text of the person or agent, sanitised.

blockSet.description: v0.5 (D42): an agent set a single block through the agent API, or would have (effect would_block: the gateway observes, nothing was blocked, no incident). Carries the address it was resolved to, like every local event; the agent never sees it. D88: also the operator in the dashboard (actor dashboard, target_kind address, no token, no evidence event); without actor it was an agent. Local only.

duration_s.description: As asked for, within the cap of the net class. No ladder step: an agent chooses it.

target_kind.description: D88: address when the operator typed the address in the dashboard.

reason.description: Text of the agent or the operator, sanitised.

blockLifted.description: v0.5 (D42): an agent ended a running block. It creates no exception and no allowlist entry. Local only.

source.description: The source of the block: behaviour:<scenario>, ratelimit:<id>, agent:<token id> or (D88) dashboard.

ruleExceptionChange.description: v0.5 (D54), v0.6 (D73): a rule exception for rules of repository crs or crowdsec was set or removed. D84: also from the dashboard (actor dashboard, no token, the reason may be empty); without actor it was an agent. Local only.

reason.description: Text of the agent or the operator, sanitised.

accessProtectionSet.description: v0.5 (D56): the access lock of a website was set or changed, from the dashboard or with schild lock on the server. Addresses are counted, the password is only named as set. Local only.

addresses.description: How many addresses and networks are listed.

accessProtectionRemoved.description: v0.5 (D56): the access lock of a website ended: removed from the dashboard or the CLI, or its end came (actor system, reason expired). Every session of it ended too. Local only.

accessLogin.description: v0.5 (D56): a successful login with the shared password of a website. Failed guesses are only counted (schild_access_logins_total). The address is kept as its prefix (/24, /48). Local only.

accessPrefixLocked.description: v0.5 (D56): an address prefix guessed the password of a website wrong 5 times within 15 minutes and may not try again until the given time. Local only.

crawlerPolicySet.description: v0.5 (D57, MVP-29): the crawler policy of a website changed, from the dashboard or through the agent API (scope crawlers:write). Holds the whole policy after the change (empty categories and bots: everything allowed). reason is the agent's text, sanitised: untrusted, render it as text. Local only.

crowdsecRuleRef.description: v0.6 (D73): which CrowdSec Hub rule of repository crowdsec matched. Hub text is third-party text: show it, never interpret it.

repositoryUpdated.description: v0.6 (D73): the rules of a repository changed or a change was refused: a crowdsec update (accepted, refused), the way back to the image snapshot (reset), a sync of local (reloaded, refused). Not written for a check or sync that found nothing new. Local only.

code.description: Refusal code; only with outcome refused. crowdsec: crowdsec-hub.md section 6. local: dir_missing, read_failed, id_range, compile_failed.

set_source.description: crowdsec only: the set running after this change.

hub_commit.description: crowdsec only, for a pinned set: the index of the master branch names no commit.

added.description: crowdsec: hub names; local: rule ids.

truncated.description: added, changed or removed lists were cut at 100.

incidentExported.description: v0.5 (D51): a dashboard user downloaded an incident with its events and context. No address, no user agent, only that it happened.

accessReset.description: v0.5 (D38, MVP-09 addendum): `schild dashboard reset-password` on the host removed the dashboard users and ended every session; first-run setup with a new one-time setup code is required. Audit record only: no password, hash, setup code or session id is ever stored.

via.description: host_cli: the CLI on the host while schild was stopped; control_path: the CLI told the running gateway through its local control path.

host_user.description: Name of the host account that ran the command (from the process credentials), if known.

clientKeyBits.description: v0.4: granularity of the client key the counters use: 32 for an IPv4 address, 64 for an IPv6 /64 (never coarser than /24 for IPv4).

behaviourReason.description: v0.4: why the action stayed below the configured mode: net_class (cgnat, mobile or tor, never blocked), allowlisted (own address), released (operator released the client or set an exception), challenge_unavailable (only in events written before D92: the old mode challenge without a browser check), unverified_bot (claims to be a search bot that could not be verified; counted, never acted on), site_scope (detected across the whole site, no single client to act on), learning (v0.4 addendum 2026-10-28: a scenario in block observes during the learning period of a fresh installation, as the distributed detectors do; behaviour scenarios only, never on rate limits, which act from day 0).

behaviourTriggered.description: v0.4 (MVP-17): a scenario over several requests triggered. Local only (E4, G1). No user name, hash, password or body. scope client: one client key; scope site: across the whole site (credential_stuffing from a pool of addresses), no client.

route.description: Path or preset route the scenario counted (redacted like request paths).

count.description: Observed events in the window: failed logins, estimated distinct user names, distinct paths (probe paths weighted), requests, distinct WAF rules.

baseline.description: aggressive_crawl: the site's per-client baseline in requests per window.

mode.description: challenge appears only in events written before D92 (no browser check).

action.description: What schild did. challenge was never taken (no browser check, D92).

would_action.description: What mode block would have done for this client (shown in observe as "hätte gesperrt").

level.description: Escalation step of a repeat offender (1 = first block).

duration_s.description: Block duration from the ladder of the client's net class (D29 amendment 2026-10-29): hosting 900, 3600, 86400, then 604800 (7 days) from level 4; every other class 900, 3600, 14400, then 86400 from level 4. Blocks over 24 h are kept in schild.db and survive a restart.

allOf.description: D29 amendment (2026-10-29): the duration is the ladder step of the level for the client's net class.

ratelimitExceeded.description: v0.4 (MVP-17): a client went over a rate limit. Written at most once per limit and client key per minute, with the number of requests over the limit since the last record. Local only.

path.description: Path of the first request over the limit (redacted).

count.description: Requests over the limit since the last record.

action.description: observe: counted ("hätte begrenzt"); block: answered 429 with Retry-After.

reason.description: v0.4 addendum 2026-10-28: never learning; rate limits act from day 0 (D29).

distributedDetected.description: v0.4 (MVP-18): a distributed attack (wave) was detected. Address-free: no client IP, no user name, no account key; the fingerprint is a local id (keyed per process, never stored beyond the window). Local only.

wave_id.description: Local wave id (random, never derived from a sender, account or host).

route.description: Path or route pattern under attack (redacted like request paths).

senders.description: Estimated distinct client keys in the window (sketch).

count.description: Failures, senders or requests that triggered, per detector.

baseline.description: route_wave: the route's own failures per window before the wave.

fingerprint.description: Local fingerprint id of the cluster (12 hex, per-process key).

user_agents.description: Distinct user agent families seen with the fingerprint.

action.description: respond: the response is enforced; observe: shown as "hätte reagiert".

reason.description: Why the action stayed observe: learning (fresh install), gateway_observe (gateway mode observe).

distributedEnded.description: v0.4 (MVP-18): a wave's response ended (expired or ended early by the operator). Local only.

wave_id.description: Local wave id (random, never derived from a sender, account or host).

stopped.description: Requests answered with 429 or 403 by the response.
